newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH SPORT GOODS RETAILERS SEE '97 SALES GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH SPORT GOODS RETAILERS SEE '97 SALES GROWTH.

text.p: Most Finnish sport goods retailers expect sales to increase in 1997 by up to 10 percent, the Sport and Leisure Wholesalers' Association said in a statement on Friday.

Nearly all respondents in a survey among its members accounting for 80 percent of the sector's turnover said the value of retail sales of sport and leisure goods would rise next year, the association said.
"Expectations for turnover growth next year are again optimistic without exception," it said.

"All companies which responded expected their turnover to rise next year. Seventy percent of the companies expected the growth to be up to 10 percent and a third thought it would be even bigger," it said.
Sport and leisure goods prices would rise at the wholesale level, but only slighty with nearly 90 percent of respondents expecting prices to rise by "a few percent".
